<style>

        /* New Warm & Elegant Theme Colors */
        :root {
            --bg-color: #f4f1ee; /* Warm Off-White */
            --text-color: #5a5349; /* Warm Gray/Brown Body Text */
            --heading-color: #4a433a; /* Darker Warm Gray/Brown Headings */
            --accent-color: #8b8173; /* Muted Khaki/Taupe Accent */
            --font-serif: 'Cormorant Garamond', serif;
            --font-sans: 'Montserrat', sans-serif;

            /* Existing non-color variables kept for structure */
            --shadow-subtle: 0 4px 12px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.05);
            --border-radius: 12px;
        }

        /* General Styles */
        body {
            font-family: var(--font-sans);
            background-color: var(--bg-color);
            color: var(--text-color);
            margin: 0;
            padding: 0;
            line-height: 1.6;
        }
        .container {
            width: 100%;
            padding: 0 20px;
            box-sizing: border-box;
        }
        h1, h2, h3 {
            font-family: var(--font-serif);
            font-weight: 700;
            line-height: 1.1;
            margin-top: 0;
            color: var(--heading-color);
        }
        p {
            font-weight: 400;
            color: var(--text-color);
        }
        b, strong {
            font-weight: 700;
            color: var(--heading-color);
        }
        section {
            padding: 60px 0;
        }
        
        /* --- Hero Section --- */
        .hero-section {
            background-image: url('/img/bbb4.avif'); 
            background-size: cover;
            background-position: center center;
            position: relative; 
            overflow: hidden;
            min-height: 400px;
            color: var(--bg-color);
            padding: 80px 20px 60px;
            border-bottom-left-radius: 40px;
            border-bottom-right-radius: 40px;
            text-align: center;
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            z-index: 1;
        }
        
        .hero-section::before {
            content: '';
            position: absolute;
            top: 0;
            left: 0;
            right: 0;
            bottom: 0;
            background-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4);
            z-index: 2;
        }
        
        .hero-section .container {
            position: relative;
            z-index: 3;
        }

        .hero-section h1 {
            font-size: clamp(30px, 5.5vw, 54px);
            font-weight: 700;
            margin-bottom: 0;
            color: var(--bg-color);
            text-shadow: none;
        }

        /* --- Content & Philosophy --- */
        .content-wrap {
            padding: 40px 0;
            max-width: 1400px;
            margin: 0 auto;
        }
        .intro-text, .philosophy-box {
            margin-bottom: 50px;
        }
        .intro-text h2 {
            font-size: clamp(26px, 3.5vw, 36px);
            margin-bottom: 20px;
            color: var(--heading-color);
            line-height: 1.25;
        }
        .philosophy-box {
            background-color: var(--bg-color);
            border: 2px solid var(--accent-color);
            padding: 30px;
            border-radius: var(--border-radius);
            box-shadow: var(--shadow-subtle);
            text-align: center;
        }
        .philosophy-box h2 {
            font-size: 32px;
            margin-bottom: 15px;
            color: var(--accent-color);
        }
        .philosophy-box p {
            font-style: italic;
            font-weight: 600;
            color: var(--text-color);
            margin-bottom: 15px;
        }
        .philosophy-box p:last-child {
            margin-bottom: 0;
        }

        /* --- Services Grid --- */
        .services-grid {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr);
            gap: 30px;
            margin-bottom: 50px;
        }
        .service-card {
            background-color: #ffffff;
            padding: 30px;
            border-radius: var(--border-radius);
            box-shadow: var(--shadow-subtle);
            border: 1px solid #eee;
            transition: transform 0.3s ease, box-shadow 0.3s ease;
        }
        .service-card:hover {
            transform: translateY(-5px);
            box-shadow: 0 8px 24px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.08);
        }
        .service-card h3 {
            font-size: 24px;
            margin-bottom: 15px;
            color: var(--heading-color);
        }
        .service-card p {
            font-size: 15px;
            line-height: 1.6;
            margin-bottom: 10px;
        }
        .service-card p:last-child {
            margin-bottom: 0;
        }
        .service-card ul {
            padding-left: 20px;
            margin: 10px 0;
        }
        .service-card li {
            font-size: 15px;
            line-height: 1.6;
            margin-bottom: 6px;
            color: var(--text-color);
        }

        /* --- Why Choose Us --- */
        .why-choose-us {
            margin-bottom: 50px;
        }
        .why-choose-us h2 {
            font-size: 32px;
            text-align: center;
            margin-bottom: 20px;
            color: var(--accent-color);
        }
        .why-choose-intro {
            text-align: center;
            max-width: 800px;
            margin: 0 auto 30px;
            font-size: 16px;
        }
        .why-choose-intro p {
            margin-bottom: 10px;
        }
        .reason-list {
            list-style: none;
            padding: 0;
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(250px, 1fr));
            gap: 20px;
        }
        .reason-list li {
            background: #ffffff;
            padding: 20px;
            border-radius: var(--border-radius);
            border-left: 5px solid var(--accent-color);
            font-size: 15px;
            box-shadow: var(--shadow-subtle);
        }
        .reason-list strong {
            display: block;
            margin-bottom: 5px;
            font-size: 16px;
            color: var(--heading-color);
        }
        .final-cta-message {
            margin-top: 30px;
            text-align: center;
            font-style: italic;
            font-size: 15px;
            color: var(--heading-color);
        }
        .final-cta-message a {
            color: var(--accent-color);
            text-decoration: underline;
            font-weight: 600;
        }

        /* --- FAQ Section --- */
        .faq-section {
            margin-bottom: 50px;
        }
        .faq-section h2 {
            font-size: 32px;
            text-align: center;
            margin-bottom: 30px;
            color: var(--accent-color);
        }
        .faq-list {
            max-width: 900px;
            margin: 0 auto;
        }
        .faq-item {
            background-color: #ffffff;
            padding: 20px;
            border-radius: var(--border-radius);
            box-shadow: var(--shadow-subtle);
            border: 1px solid #eee;
            margin-bottom: 15px;
        }
        .faq-q {
            font-size: 18px;
            color: var(--heading-color);
            margin-bottom: 10px;
        }
        .faq-a {
            font-size: 15px;
            color: var(--text-color);
            line-height: 1.6;
            margin: 0;
        }

        /* Learn More Button */
        .learn-more-wrap {
            text-align: center;
            margin-top: 35px;
            margin-bottom: 20px;
        }
        .learn-more-btn {
            display: inline-block;
            background-color: var(--accent-color);
            color: #ffffff;
            font-size: 16px;
            font-weight: 600;
            padding: 14px 38px;
            border-radius: 30px;
            text-decoration: none;
            transition: all 0.3s ease;
            box-shadow: 0 4px 15px rgba(139, 129, 115, 0.3);
            letter-spacing: 0.5px;
        }
        .learn-more-btn:hover {
            background-color: var(--heading-color);
            color: #ffffff;
            transform: translateY(-2px);
            box-shadow: 0 6px 20px rgba(74, 67, 58, 0.4);
        }

        /* --- Closing Section --- */
        .closing-section {
            padding: 40px;
            background-color: #ffffff;
            border-radius: var(--border-radius);
            box-shadow: var(--shadow-subtle);
            border: 1px solid #eee;
            margin-top: 30px;
            text-align: center;
        }
        .closing-section h2 {
            font-size: 32px;
            color: var(--accent-color);
            margin-bottom: 15px;
        }
        .closing-section p {
            max-width: 900px;
            margin: 0 auto 15px;
            font-size: 16px;
            line-height: 1.7;
        }
        .closing-section p a {
            color: var(--accent-color);
            font-weight: 600;
            text-decoration: underline;
        }

        /* --- Work Done / Project Showcase Gallery Carousel --- */
        .work-gallery-section {
            margin-top: 50px;
            margin-bottom: 50px;
            position: relative;
            overflow: hidden;
        }
        .gallery-header {
            text-align: center;
            margin-bottom: 35px;
            padding: 0 20px;
        }
        .gallery-header h2 {
            font-size: clamp(26px, 4vw, 36px);
            margin-bottom: 12px;
            color: var(--heading-color);
        }
        .gallery-header p {
            font-size: 16px;
            max-width: 750px;
            margin: 0 auto;
            color: var(--text-color);
        }
        .gallery-carousel-wrapper {
            width: 100%;
            overflow: hidden;
            position: relative;
            padding: 15px 0 25px;
            -webkit-mask-image: linear-gradient(to right, transparent, black 4%, black 96%, transparent);
            mask-image: linear-gradient(to right, transparent, black 4%, black 96%, transparent);
        }
        .gallery-carousel-track {
            display: flex;
            width: max-content;
            animation: infiniteGalleryScroll 30s linear infinite;
            will-change: transform;
        }
        .gallery-carousel-wrapper:hover .gallery-carousel-track,
        .gallery-carousel-wrapper:active .gallery-carousel-track {
            animation-play-state: paused;
        }
        .gallery-carousel-group {
            display: flex;
            gap: 25px;
            padding-right: 25px;
            flex-shrink: 0;
        }
        .gallery-card {
            width: 320px;
            max-width: 340px;
            background-color: #ffffff;
            border-radius: var(--border-radius);
            overflow: hidden;
            box-shadow: var(--shadow-subtle);
            border: 1px solid rgba(139, 129, 115, 0.2);
            transition: transform 0.35s ease, box-shadow 0.35s ease, border-color 0.35s ease;
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            flex-shrink: 0;
        }
        .gallery-card:hover {
            transform: translateY(-8px);
            box-shadow: 0 14px 30px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.12);
            border-color: var(--accent-color);
        }
        .gallery-img-wrap {
            width: 100%;
            height: 240px;
            overflow: hidden;
            position: relative;
            background-color: #e5e0d8;
            border-radius: inherit;
        }
        .gallery-img-wrap img {
            width: 100%;
            height: 100%;
            object-fit: cover;
            display: block;
            transition: transform 0.6s ease;
        }
        .gallery-card:hover .gallery-img-wrap img {
            transform: scale(1.08);
        }
        @keyframes infiniteGalleryScroll {
            0% {
                transform: translate3d(0, 0, 0);
            }
            100% {
                transform: translate3d(-25%, 0, 0);
            }
        }
        @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
            .gallery-carousel-track {
                animation: none;
            }
            .gallery-carousel-wrapper {
                overflow-x: auto;
                -webkit-mask-image: none;
                mask-image: none;
            }
        }        /* Mobile Responsiveness */
        @media (max-width: 767px) {
            .hero-section {
                padding: 60px 16px 40px;
                border-radius: 0;
            }
            .content-wrap.container {
                padding-left: 0;
                padding-right: 0;
                padding-top: 25px;
                padding-bottom: 25px;
            }
            .intro-text {
                width: calc(100% - 32px);
                max-width: 100%;
                margin-left: auto;
                margin-right: auto;
                box-sizing: border-box;
                margin-bottom: 35px;
            }
            .intro-text h2 {
                font-size: clamp(1.6rem, 6.5vw, 2.1rem);
                line-height: 1.22;
                margin-bottom: 16px;
            }
            .intro-text p {
                font-size: 16px;
                line-height: 1.7;
                margin-bottom: 15px;
            }
            .philosophy-box {
                width: calc(100% - 32px);
                max-width: 100%;
                margin-left: auto;
                margin-right: auto;
                padding: 26px 16px;
                border-radius: 16px;
                box-sizing: border-box;
                overflow: hidden;
                margin-bottom: 40px;
            }
            .philosophy-box h2 {
                margin: 0 0 22px;
                text-align: center;
                font-size: clamp(1.85rem, 7vw, 2.25rem);
                line-height: 1.18;
                overflow-wrap: break-word;
            }
            .philosophy-box p {
                width: 100%;
                margin: 0 0 20px;
                padding: 0;
                text-align: left;
                text-indent: 0;
                font-size: 17px;
                line-height: 1.7;
                overflow-wrap: break-word;
                word-break: normal;
                hyphens: none;
            }
            .philosophy-box p:last-child {
                margin-bottom: 0;
            }
            .services-grid {
                grid-template-columns: 1fr;
                gap: 20px;
                width: calc(100% - 32px);
                margin-left: auto;
                margin-right: auto;
                box-sizing: border-box;
                margin-bottom: 40px;
            }
            .why-choose-us,
            .faq-section {
                width: calc(100% - 32px);
                margin-left: auto;
                margin-right: auto;
                box-sizing: border-box;
            }
            .gallery-card {
                width: 280px;
            }
            .gallery-img-wrap {
                height: 200px;
            }
            .gallery-carousel-group {
                gap: 18px;
                padding-right: 18px;
            }
            .gallery-carousel-track {
                animation-duration: 22s;
            }
            .closing-section {
                width: calc(100% - 32px);
                margin-left: auto;
                margin-right: auto;
                box-sizing: border-box;
                padding: 25px 16px;
                border-radius: 16px;
            }
            .process-card-row {
                flex-direction: column;
            }
        }

        @media (min-width: 481px) and (max-width: 767px) {
            .intro-text,
            .philosophy-box,
            .services-grid,
            .why-choose-us,
            .faq-section,
            .closing-section {
                width: calc(100% - 40px);
            }
        }
    </style>

    <!-- HERO SECTION -->
    <section class="hero-section">
        <div class="container">
            <h1>Architecture Services in Delhi</h1>
        </div>
    </section>

    <!-- MAIN CONTENT WRAPPER -->
    <div class="container content-wrap">

        <!-- INTRO -->
        <div class="intro-text">
            <h2>Thoughtful Planning with Professional Architecture Services</h2>
            <p>Good architecture creates spaces that work efficiently, feel comfortable, look attractive, and are right for the people who use them. <b>Architecture Services in Delhi</b> help transform ideas into well-designed built spaces for homes, offices, commercial properties, and retail developments.</p>
            <p>Our approach starts with understanding client needs, lifestyle, business goals, and future expansion plans. We analyze natural light, ventilation, circulation, structural frameworks, and practical zoning to create buildings that are sustainable and easy to maintain.</p>
        </div>

        <!-- PHILOSOPHY / SERVICE OVERVIEW -->
        <div class="philosophy-box">
            <h2>Creating Functional Spaces with Professional Building Design</h2>
            <p>Architecture is more than just building envelopes; it is the creation of living environments that enable daily activities and respond to their location. Our architecture services in Delhi focus on achieving a harmonious balance of capacity, aesthetics, ease, and enduring style.</p>
            <p>Each project is individually designed for its site orientation. Our design process considers spatial volume, daylighting, air circulation, building materials, and lasting functionality to project a distinctive, timeless identity.</p>
        </div>

        <!-- SERVICE CATEGORIES GRID (4 CARDS) -->
        <div class="services-grid">
            
            <div class="service-card">
                <h3>Residential and Commercial Architecture</h3>
                <p>A home should be comfortable, personal, and well laid out. We design residences that reflect how families live, coordinating rooms, circulation, natural lighting, and outdoor courtyards holistically.</p>
                <p>Commercial architectural planning focuses on creating productive, flexible work environments for employees and welcoming facilities for clients.</p>
                <p>For private residences, <b>residential architecture planning in Delhi</b> establishes an elegant balance between indoor living, natural ventilation, and landscaped gardens.</p>
            </div>
            
            <div class="service-card">
                <h3>Retail & Landscape Architecture</h3>
                <p>Retail and showroom spaces require strategic layouts that optimize customer movement, visual sightlines, and product display impact.</p>
                <p><b>Delhi’s retail architecture services</b> focus on creating engaging, functional commercial destinations. Landscape planning incorporates terraces, verandas, walkways, and garden courtyards that seamlessly link architecture with nature.</p>
            </div>
            
            <div class="service-card">
                <h3>Visualisation & Interior Architecture</h3>
                <p>Interior architecture bridges the relationship between interior spaces and the structural building envelope. Partitions, ceiling heights, joinery, and lighting are planned together.</p>
                <p>Photorealistic 3D modeling and visualization help clients looking for <b>Interior Architecture Solutions in Delhi</b> review materials, massing, and volumes before construction commences, allowing confident decision-making.</p>
            </div>
            
            <div class="service-card">
                <h3>Sustainable Design & Optimal Space Planning</h3>
